Opportunity to network with Nestlé employees globally. jobs.description: Employer: Ankura Expires: 10/11/2026 Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.Practice Overview: This position supports the Ankura Construction, Disputes & Advisory Business Group – one of five practices focused on client delivery services across the firm. Ankura’s Forensic Accounting and Claims Consulting (FACC) practice focuses on assisting corporations in the quantification and presentation of first party insurance claims as a result of a covered loss. Commonly this entails the calculation of business interruption and extra expense losses. The FACC practice works with its clients to build financial models that quantify these insured losses, and then assists in the claim audit and settlement processes. Role Overview: Our Summer Internship Program has been created to give students an opportunity to learn what life as a consultant in our Forensic Accounting & Claims practice is like at Ankura. As an Intern, you will work on a variety of projects with different engagement teams. The program aims to give you exposure to the breadth of our services and client work. You will work closely with our professionals – Consultants through Director – and gain first-hand experience in consulting. Your assignments may involve work in fact-finding, allocating costs, analyzing damages, organizing information, or helping to manage data. Responsibilities: Design financial and accounting models that quantify business interruption, extra expense, property damage, cyber product recall, and employee fidelity insurance claim losses on the policy holder’s behalf including revenue and expense forecasting. Prepare annual business interruption and property renewal values for companies in various industries. Analyze financial statements and other pertinent documentation. Develop sensitivity analyses related to loss measurements. Reconciliation of claim amounts to accounting systems and to insurers’ calculations. Simultaneously participate on multiple engagements with varying project size and scope. Requirements: Pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028. Strong computer and data management skills (Excel, Access and Microsoft Word) Demonstrate a strong attention to detail and strong organizational/time management skills Ability to prioritize and work comfortably in a fast-paced environment Commitment to quality and working within a team Effective written and oral communication skills Please note that this role requires permanent authorization to work in the U.S. (i.e. U.S. citizen or permanent resident). Internships and full-time University Associate roles are not eligible for U.S. immigration sponsorship, work visa or any other temporary work authorization (i.e. OPT, CPT). Ankura is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. A reasonable estimate of the current payrate for this internship is: $34/hr. Ankura is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. jobs.description: Employer: The Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation Expires: 10/11/2026 Internship Opportunity at the Ronald Reagan InstituteWashington, DC; In-PersonINTERNSHIP TERM: January-May Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation & InstituteThe Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation and Institute (RRPFI) is the sole nonprofit organization created by President Reagan charged with advancing his legacy and principles – individual liberty, economic opportunity, freedom and democracy, peace through strength, and national pride. jobs.title: Protiviti Business Performance Improvement Intern - 2027 at Protiviti
jobs.description: Employer: Protiviti Expires: 10/11/2026 Protiviti Business Performance Improvement Intern - 2027 Are You Ready to Live Something Different with Protiviti? The Protiviti career provides an opportunity to learn, shape outcomes, and grow within a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture. We hire curious individuals who are motivated by learning and who are driven to make an impact. By teaming with our clients, we solve the business challenges a dynamic world presents and discover and implement innovative business solutions. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver. At every level, we champion leaders who live our values. Imagining our work as a journey, integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver high-quality, client-focused outcomes in pursuit of our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm. Are you inspired to make a difference? You've come to the right place. POSITION HIGHLIGHTS Business Performance Improvement interns help clients in the areas of finance, operations, people and change. Our Interns work with Protiviti’s clients, who are typically among the world’s leading companies. As an intern, you collaborate with the team to deliver high- quality, client-focused solutions to complex business problems these organizations face. Experience tells us that our future leaders need to be both knowledgeable and demonstrate depth in an area of expertise but also versatile, having a broad range of capabilities and skill sets to solve today’s complex business problems. That’s why we focus on developing interns across our business, so you gain experience in different industries, grow your technical and professional capabilities, and gain leadership qualities that will ensure your future success. Our culture is built on clear expectations, meaningful support, and teamwork. Interns are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn through real work, and collaborate closely with others. Our people invest in one another; coaching, guiding, and supporting each team member to grow and perform at their best.When you join our team, you will participate in Liftoff with Protiviti, our award-winning onboarding live-virtual experience with gamification embedded in the delivery. You will also attend The Intern Challenge, an experiential learning course that will help you build confidence and create connections that will help you transition successfully into your role as an intern. Protiviti’s internship is an innovative experience designed to take you on a journey to immerse you in our unique business and culture. Through our internship, you may work across various industries and engage in internal initiatives, all of which will fuel your curiosity, uncover hidden strengths, and prepare you for your career. During the internship, you will get a preview of Foundations, Protiviti’s innovative entry-level full-time career opportunity, which provides you with experiences and learning opportunities in business operations, consulting, data, relationship building, technology, and innovation. With each project, you receive hands-on training in a supportive, high-performance environment and interact with leaders across our practice. Talent Managers will assign specific project experiences that support career growth, your skills, and the needs of the business. A network of advisors will help you navigate challenges and celebrate milestones. There are opportunities to join committees, participate in employee network groups, enjoy social, civic, and networking activities to strengthen connections and build meaningful relationships across our firm and in the community. Business Performance Improvement interns are hired into one of four different areas, including:Finance Performance Management: Provides custom solutions to help finance leaders address their current challenges and explore opportunities for continuous growth, delivering innovative solutions and supporting finance as a forward-thinking, strategic partner to the business. At the core, our methodology aligns people, processes, and technology to drive efficiency, productivity, and transformation, enabling change and creating value for the entire client organization.Financial Reporting Remediation & Compliance: Supports companies in navigating complex financial reporting situations to reduce their risk of non-compliance while limiting exposure to financial restatements and other costly non-routine situations such as restatements, mergers, and IPOs. Protiviti’s team proactively monitors new accounting rules, alerts clients to changing requirements, and assists with addressing complex accounting or reporting challenges.People & Change: Focuses on the human side of transformation by helping companies with the people, talent, and skills components of their business. We assist organizations in developing differentiated employee experiences to better attract, retain, and engage talent. We also help organizations enable sustained behavior changes to support large-scale initiatives. Supply Chain & Operations: Supports companies in driving outcomes by reducing cost, improving efficiency, reducing risk and executing operations across their complex business functions from Engineering, Source, Make and Deliver through industry-leading practices and innovation. Meaningful onboarding. Impactful training. Foundational learning. These experiences define Protiviti’s award-winning internship – an experience that builds upon your skills and knowledge and enables you to thrive professionally. QUALIFICATIONSDegree: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Project Management, Supply Chain, or other business majors) Visa Status: All applicants applying for U.S. job openings need authorization to work in the United States for Protiviti without sponsorship now or in the futureGraduation Status: Must be within one year of final graduation at the time of internshipExperience solving problems using AI-powered productivity and collaboration tools (i.e. Microsoft Copilot, GenAI, etc.)Advanced verbal and written communication skillsAbility to apply critical thinking skills and innovation to client engagements across various industriesTechnical proficiency aligning to assigned capability area WHAT MAKES YOU SUCCESSFULWorks effectively in teams, as well as independentlyBeing creative and analyticalPassionate about evaluating, synthesizing, organizing, and interpreting data and informationEmbraces challenges with a growth mindset and contributes to meaningful outcomesSeeks feedback and guidance to strengthen performanceDrive towards obtaining professional certifications and a strong academic backgroundRelevant experience with specific skills:A foundation in accounting and finance processes and objectivesDocumenting findings and sharing recommendationsEntry level knowledge of organizational operations processes and objectives HOW WE WORK Protiviti practices a hybrid model, combining in-person with purpose and remote work to best support excellent work, connection and collaboration. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. We encourage thoughtful choices about where work happens – making decisions that best support client outcomes, team effectiveness and learning. The requirements will vary by client, project, team and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments. Interns do not accrue company paid time off (Choice Time Off), and we expect that interns will be available to complete work in the designated location during business hours for the entire duration of the Internship. APPLICATION PROCESS Apply at www.protiviti.com/careers.Note: Students may apply for only one location or capability. Duplicate applications will not be accepted. Applicants must be 18 years of age at the time of the internship to be considered. #LI-DNI The hourly rate for this position is below.$28/hr-$38/hr Interns participate in a variety of professional development opportunities and are eligible for paid holidays that occur within the duration of the internship, Protiviti’s 401(k) plan, Employee Assistance Program, Matching Gifts Program, and various discounts through PerkSpot. Protiviti is an Equal Opportunity Employer. M/F/Disability/Veteran As part of Protiviti’s employment process, any offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Protiviti is committed to being an equal employment employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us by sending an email to HRSolutions@roberthalf.com or call 1.855.744.6947 for assistance. In your email please include the following:The specific accommodation requested to complete the employment application.The location(s) (city, state) to which you would like to apply. For positions located in Los Angeles County, CA: Protiviti will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Both our client service and culture are second to none, stemming from our firmwide embrace of our core values: Positive and Team-Oriented, Accountable, Committed, Relationship-Focused, Super-Responsive, and being Great communicators. Sound like a place you can grow and succeed? Read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity to join our team.Intern – Complex SecuritiesStout’s Complex Securities team provides analysis and valuation related to complex securities and other financial instruments for financial reporting, tax and regulatory compliance, risk management and hedging assessments, transaction support and corporate strategy.We use reliable valuation methodologies coupled with sophisticated techniques from quantitative finance to assist clients in understanding and valuing financial derivatives and other complex securities. We work on a wide variety of projects, giving team members the opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of securities and situations. In addition, we provide the opportunity to everyone on the team to be able to have client facing meetings, where they get to explain the approach used and the key value drivers to our clients.What You’ll DoDevelop and apply complex valuation models to value a variety of financial instruments using option pricing theory, interest rate and credit models, Monte Carlo simulation, binomial trees, contingent claims analysis, and other financial engineering techniques;Perform independent analyses and interpret and analyze data sets to generate strategic insights and recommendations for senior leadership and clients;Create comprehensive reports and supporting analyses that synthesize complex financial analyses delivering clear, concise and impactful findings and recommendations to clients, demonstrating advanced analytical and communication skills;Independently manage multiple complex projects, exercising discretion in prioritizing tasks and effectively communicating technical insights and recommendations to colleagues and clients in engagements;Cultivate and sustain strategic professional relationships with colleagues and clients, proactively identifying client’s needs, tailoring solutions, and delivering precise, actionable request for information to drive successful outcomes; andAssume full ownership of complex projects, exercising independent judgment while collaborating strategically with colleagues.Qualifications:Pursuing a BA/BS/MS degree in Financial Engineering, Computational Finance, Mathematical Finance, Finance, Business Analytics, or related discipline (required).Minimum cumulative G.P.A. of 3.0 required; 3.5 or higher preferred.Must be classified as Junior or higher.Demonstrated understanding of valuation methodologies used in financial markets preferred.Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).Experience with programming languages (Python, R, VBA).Relevant internship and/or extracurricular related experiences.Strong analytical, verbal, technical, and written skills with ability to interpret complex financial data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insight.Superior Communication and interpersonal skills, including ability to present complex information and build strong relationships with colleagues and clients.How You’ll ThriveLeverage specialized expertise in strong derivative and financial modeling skills to independently design and implement valuation and financial models for financial assets, agreements, or an operational and financial business plans, utilizing techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation, lattice techniques, and finite difference methods.Build and demonstrate strong quantitative and problem-solving skills.Leverage tools such as Bloomberg analytics and S&P CapIQ preferred.Excel in a fast-paced, collaborative environment exercising discretion in managing multiple complex projects with meticulous attention to detail and strong organization skills.Excel in multi-tasking, planning and organization skills, along with strong attention to detail.Demonstrate a proactive commitment to deepening expertise in financial markets and investments, driving innovative solutions for clients.Communicate sophisticated technical, financial, and modeling concepts with clarity and precision, tailoring insights to meet the needs of clients and colleagues in deadline driven settings. Why Stout?At Stout, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards program with competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness options tailored to support employees at every stage of life.We foster a culture of inclusion and respect, embracing diverse perspectives and experiences to drive innovation and success. Our leadership is committed to inclusion and belonging across the organization and in the communities we serve.We invest in professional growth through ongoing training, mentorship, employee resource groups, and clear performance feedback, ensuring our employees are supported in achieving their career goals.Stout provides flexible work schedules and a discretionary time off policy to promote work-life balance and help employees lead fulfilling lives.Learn more about our benefits and commitment to your success.https://www.stout.com/en/careers/benefitsThe specific statements shown in each section of this description are not intended to be all-inclusive. jobs.description: Employer: KLN Family Brands Expires: 10/11/2026 Operations Management InternshipKLN Family Brands/Tuffy's Pet Foods College Juniors and Seniors…We’re looking for you! Our Story KLN Family Brands is a 3rd generation family-owned business that started in 1964 with its corporate headquarters located in Perham, MN, in the heart of MN lakes country. Together, our companies manufacture a diverse and expanding range of high-quality human and pet food products. At KLN Family Brands, our vision is that “We are a proud people-first company. We are successful because of trust-based relationships, and first-rate products for our families and friends. We better the world by caring for others. We challenge. We grow. We inspire.” Some companies have to “fudge the story” a little. Some need the extra “spin” to shine a positive light on themselves. That’s not who we are at KLN Family Brands, and that’s not what we do. We tell the story of our brand – our people, the quality & safety of our products, our tradition & trust, our bold innovation, and the way we treat our community & beyond. We do it in a genuine way because we genuinely believe we’re a pretty amazing company. We’re looking for an Operations Management Intern for the summer of 2027 that is serious about a career in manufacturing. If you are willing to learn from the best and have a desire to participate in the growth of some of the fastest growing brands in the pet food industry, you’ve stumbled upon the right job. The Opportunity As an Operations Management Intern, you’ll work closely with our Production Manager and the entire operations team. Daily Duties and Responsibilities:Gain hands-on experience in the production area to develop an understanding of the process from start to finishSupport 2027 strategic initiatives through projects that could include:Analyzing production lines to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvementProposing workflow layouts that improve efficiency and reduce cycle timeEvaluating Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) to identify opportunities for equipment and process improvementsYou Will Learn Things Like:Innovation and creativityGoal setting and KPI measurementAnalytical and critical thinkingProblem solvingOral and written communicationTeamwork and leadership What You’ll Need to Be Successful at KLN Family Brands/Tuffy’s Pet Foods:At least a Junior in college pursuing a degree in Operations Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related fieldThe ability to dedicate 10-12 weeks to the internship program for the summer of 2027A positive attitude and willingness to learnThe ability to work in a team atmosphere and be a great co-workerThe ability to work on-site at our Perham, MN facility for the summer Compensation The starting hourly rate of pay is $17.94 and will be a percentage of industry standards based on typical full-time starting salaries, and will depend on your year in school and timeline to graduation. Potential Interns who demonstrate exceptional performance and a passion for our business may have the opportunity for full-time employment upon graduation.

jobs.title: Consulting Intern Summer 2027 at Newton Consulting
jobs.description: Employer: Newton Consulting Expires: 10/11/2026 About NewtonAt Newton, we are a consultancy that helps organizations realize their strategic ambitions, translating them into real-world outcomes. Specializing in the defense, consumer and public sectors, we need exceptional professionals to create bold, fresh thinking.About the RoleAs a Consulting Intern, you’ll spend eight weeks working on real client challenges in a supportive team environment. From day one, we’re here to help you experience what it means to be a Newton consultant – harnessing your skills and giving you the chance to make a genuine impact. You’ll partner with exceptional people and clients from a diverse range of backgrounds across the Consumer Products and Retail sectors, working throughout North America.The program mirrors the early experience of our full-time Consultants. You’ll analyze data, find important opportunities, and help shape unexpected but effective solutions – working hand-in-hand with clients, mapping processes, and identifying opportunities for operational improvement.Complex challenges require sophisticated solutions. Newton understands that by building our core Operations, Digital & AI and People & Change capabilities, we will have diverse teams in place to deliver the best outcomes for clients. All our interns build the same core Operations Consultant skillset that our full-time Consultants develop – the fundamentals of consulting and the Newton methodology.The program is designed to identify and develop future Consultant talent. Interns who successfully complete the program are considered for a return offer, with anticipated full-time start dates between Summer and Fall 2028.Program StructureProgram Length: 8 weeks, June–July 2027Weeks 1–2 – UK Induction & Onboarding: you’ll travel to our Oxfordshire headquarters to onboard alongside our incoming Consultant hires, gaining exposure to Newton’s methodology, culture, and global business, with the chance to network with consultants and leadership and shadow live project and client activity.Weeks 3–8 – North America Client Experience: you’ll return to the U.S. and be assigned to an active client engagement, contributing alongside a project team while receiving coaching and support from experienced Consultants and Program Site Managers.Throughout the program, you’ll be assigned a Line Manager and a Buddy/Mentor, with weekly check-ins, a Midpoint Engagement Review (Week 5), and a Final Engagement Review (Week 8) covering your performance, consulting competencies, and readiness for a return offer with an anticipated start date between Summer and Fall 2028.You’ll close out the program with a 7–10 minute presentation at a Chicago-based Review Day, sharing your client contributions, key lessons learned, and recommendations for future cohorts.The Key DetailsJob Location: United States, with frequent travel to client sitesCandidates may apply from anywhere in the United States but must reside in Colorado, Illinois, Massachusetts, or North Carolina for the duration of the internship. Interns should expect frequent travel to client sites across the country, with travel and accommodation provided by Newton.Newton Consulting Headquarters: Oxfordshire/London, United KingdomUK Induction: approximately 2 weeks at our Oxfordshire headquarters at the start of the programCompensation & SupportPay: approximately $43.27 per hour (based on a $90,000 annualized rate)Hotel accommodation provided during travel weeks for client engagementsBreakfast and dinner provided during travel weeks for client engagementsQualificationsEducation & Degree Requirements: Candidates must be currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028, in one of the following approved majors or a closely related or similar field with relevant coursework.Engineering: Aerospace Engineering; Agriculture & Biological Engineering; Automation Engineering; Automotive Engineering; Biomedical Engineering; Chemical Engineering; Civil or Environmental Engineering; Computer Engineering; Construction Engineering; Electrical Engineering; Energy Engineering; General Engineering; Industrial Engineering; Materials Science & Engineering; Mechanical Engineering; Nautical or Naval Engineering; Network Engineering; Nuclear Engineering; Packaging Engineering.Business: Actuarial Science or Risk Analysis; Business Analytics; Consulting; Finance and Financial Management; Economics; Supply Chain Management; Accounting (or closely related quantitative business fields).Computer Science, Information Systems & Technology: Computer Programming; Computer Science; Computer Systems Networking & Telecommunications; Cyber Security; Data Mining; Data Science; Information Systems Management; Library Sciences; Software Design; User Experience or Social Computing.Math & Physical Sciences: Astronomy or Space Exploration; Aviation; Chemistry; Mathematics; Physics; Statistics.Natural & Applied Sciences: Earth Sciences or similar applied science disciplines.Social & Cognitive Sciences: Cognition & Neuroscience or Biopsychology or related analytical disciplines.A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 is required across all disciplines.Strong problem-solving ability through quantitative and qualitative analysis.Excellent verbal and written communication skills.Within a broader project, the ability to contribute to an independent workstream, leveraging appropriate prioritization, resourcefulness, time management and leadership skills.Must reside within a reasonable commutable distance to Chicago, IL for work purposes using own means of transportation, such as a personal vehicle or public transportation.Ability to travel and work on-site at client premises as needed between Monday–Friday during standard business hours.Authorization to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.What We Look ForWe assess everyone on their own merits. Whatever your background, it’s your analytical problem-solving skills and dedication to going the extra mile for our clients that will set you apart. This is what helps us deliver the most creative and effective solutions for our clients.1. Analytical & Problem-Solving CapabilityAn analytical approach combined with the drive to get stuck into a complex challenge. You’ll always want to deliver above expectation and be ready to tackle difficult projects.2. Drive & ResilienceYou’ll seize opportunities, pursue excellence and develop rapidly – pushing the limits of what’s possible. You’ll navigate the highs and lows to deliver exceptional outcomes.3. CuriosityFascinated by possibilities and opportunities, you’ll be drawn to new ideas and committed to unlocking your own potential.4. Empathy & Self-AwarenessYou’ll have EQ as well as IQ. You’ll demonstrate awareness of the differences in the world around you and show empathy and compassion. You’ll understand your own strengths and recognize where you can improve, giving and receiving feedback and support with care and consideration.5. Team Spirit and HumilityYou’ll value collaboration and recognize the importance of sharing skills and knowledge. You’ll know when to ask for help – and when to offer it.6. Exceptional People SkillsExceptional people with exceptional people skills. Your talent for simplifying complex issues and presenting them in a compelling way will mean you fit right in. You’ll inspire others to aspire to more.7. Agility & AdaptabilityPace, complexity and impact. You’ll need to be ready for them all. You’ll learn, adapt quickly, and always be ready for more. Things move and change fast at Newton, so you’ll need to recognize your own boundaries and manage your time to deliver.

jobs.title: International Vendor Coordinator at Namify
jobs.description: Employer: Namify Expires: 10/11/2026 ABOUT US:Namify is in the business of belonging. For over 20 years, companies of all sizes have partnered with us to elevate their recognition programs, corporate gifting strategies, branding initiatives, and employee engagement. Through automation and more sustainable practices, we are revolutionizing the swag industry which has traditionally been wasteful and awkward. We’re growing fast because the world recognizes how desperately services like ours are needed. Now we are looking for energetic “inclusion superheroes” to join our team. So, if you are a detail-oriented person and like the idea of creating more happiness in the workplace, we want to talk to you … like yesterday.ABOUT THIS JOB:As an International Vendor Coordinator Intern, you will support a variety of projects related to process optimization, market analysis, and cross-border communication initiatives. This temporary internship provides hands-on experience in a global business environment, with opportunities to develop problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.The ideal candidate will be pursuing a degree in Global Supply Chain Management, International Relations, Business Administration, Economics, or a related business field and will be comfortable working across different cultures, teams, and time zones as needed.RESPONSIBILITIES:● Manage correspondence between international teams, vendors, and partner organizations● Conduct market research and analyze operational data● Prepare reports for management● Assist with process optimization initiatives and project management tasks● Audit product costs, weights, and dimensions for accuracy and efficiency● Review vendor costs and key processes to identify opportunities for accuracy and efficiency● Assist with compliance documentation● Support logistics planning● Participate in meetings with vendors or partner organizations● Collaborate with teams across different countries● Perform other related duties as assignedTaking ownership and pride in these tasks will allow you to thrive in this position for the benefit of both your team, Namify and our clients, and most importantly yourself. A reflection of your care and dedication to our client’s needs will be seen in the quality of your work, and won’t go overlooked. You are to be accountable for results and should take ownership of your area, processes, and communications seriously, while still having a rewarding and pleasant experience working for our company.

jobs.description: Employer: Fact Professional Inc. Expires: 10/11/2026 DescriptionFACT Professional Inc. is a full-service tax and accounting firm in Canoga Park looking for accounting students who want to see how a CPA firm actually works, up close. This is a paid summer internship built for students on the accounting and CPA track who want real, varied exposure to the profession.Here you will not be one of dozens of interns parked on a single repetitive task. Your first two weeks are a guided rotation across the firm, from accounting and tax through payroll and the operational side of the practice, so you understand how the pieces of a CPA firm fit together. From there we place you where your interest and our summer work line up, with a working accountant as your mentor, doing the kind of entry-level client work a first-year associate would do.You will also follow the whole arc of a client engagement, from the early accounting work through review to the final product that goes back to the client. That includes pitching in on the operational work that keeps engagements moving.We hire from our internship program. Several of our team members started as interns. If you are strong and we are a fit, we want to know you before you graduate.What you'll gainExposure to the full arc of a client engagement, not just one isolated taskHands-on experience across tax, accounting, and payrollA dedicated mentor and direct access to the firm's accountants and partnersA clear picture of the CPA path from people actually on itMeaningful, resume-worthy experience at a growing firmWho we're looking forCurrently enrolled accounting majors, ideally on the CPA trackRising seniors preferred (entering their final year in fall 2027); rising juniors welcome to applyGenuine interest in public accounting as a careerHelpful skills and backgroundComfortable with Excel (formulas, sorting, basic spreadsheets)Familiarity with accounting software like QuickBooks is a plus, not requiredSolid written and verbal communicationOrganized, accurate, and careful with detailsAble to juggle a few tasks and ask questions when something is unclearThe detailsCompensation: $19/hourDuration and schedule: 8 weeks over summer 2027, part-time, approximately 4 hours per day (about 20 hours per week).Course credit: This internship can be used for course credit. We provide the offer letter and supervisor sign-off your program requires.Openings: 2To apply: Submit your resume through Handshake, along with a short cover letter (a few paragraphs) telling us what draws you to public accounting and why you want to intern somewhere like FACT, rather than at a large firm. We read these closely, so make it your own.Selection processApplication review of your resume, cover letter, and a short online assessmentA brief interview with shortlisted candidatesAn offer to the selected interns, with the internship itself beginning in summer

inventory concerns, trends, and opportunities· Utilize analytical skills to make data driven decisions to correctly manage and allocate inventory· Provide critical input into determining how to most goals· Understand the role of Supply Chain to balance and adjust levels of inventory flow to stores Buying (Assistant Buyer Intern):The goal of an assistant buyer intern is to gain insight into how a department level merchandise strategy is built, an assortment is chosen to support the strategy (including the private brands) and how these align to meet the financial expectations.· Discuss the senior leadership through our exclusive, intern only, Senior Leadership Speakers Series which includes a fireside chat with our CEO!· Opportunities to “live the brand” and experience summer fun outside the office through various events sponsored by DICK’S Sporting Goods· Fully furnished summer housing is provided for interns who reside outside of the Metro Pittsburgh area or a travel stipend will be provided for local interns· Working a 40 hour work week, Monday – Friday QualificationsSkills we are looking for:· A competitive spirit with a passion for results· An interest and confidence in working with data and numbers; strong mathematical/quantitative skills highly preferred· Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to independently make data-driven recommendations· Strong proficiency in Excel· A curiosity and desire to learn about consumer and retail trends, including customer demographics, purchasing influencers and emerging technology· Dynamic written and verbal communication style to read and write reports, as well as communicate cross functionally and vertically throughout the organization· Ability to work in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented environment Fashion Merchandising, Finance, Economics, or related· An ability to relocate to the Pittsburgh, PA area for the summer Start Date: May 17, 2027End Date: July 29, 2027 Full-time opportunities in 2028:Interns will be evaluated at the end of the program for full-time positions in 2028. My project challenged me into creating something I am beyond proud of, and every relationship I built along the way is one I hope to maintain for years to come. I truly don't think I could have had a better summer anywhere else!” Mallory Johnson, People & Purpose (HR) Intern “What I loved most about my internship at DSG was the opportunity to take ownership of a meaningful project that delivered real business value. The experience strengthened both my technical skills and my confidence as a professional in this industry.” – Kevin Dong, Software Engineering Intern “This internship allowed me to step out of my comfort zone by learning an entirely new area of business. Overall, I felt empowered to grow both professionally and personally, reaching my fullest potential while gaining valuable experience and confidence.” – Morgan Cartwright, Merchandising Intern “I loved that I had the chance to work on addressing real business needs through my project. This is definitely a company that I have been excited to get up and work for every day, and I'm super grateful to have had an internship here this summer!” – Jaeden Casasnovas, Retail Analytics Intern Interested in learning more? jobs.description: Employer: Motorola Solutions, Inc. Expires: 10/12/2026 Please ensure that any application submitted for this role is submitted via the Motorola Solutions careers website. Applications submitted through Handshake will not be considered. Company OverviewAt Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.Department OverviewThe Supply Chain organization is a fast-paced and dynamic environment, delivering world-class communications equipment and solutions for customers around the world. Our purpose is to deliver exceptional value and customer experience through agility, speed, and collaboration. We plan what products and services are needed, source efficiently and ethically from a diverse supply base, launch new products, make and deliver solutions on time, and exceed customer expectations through outstanding quality, service and support. We are designed to bring value, lead technology innovation, and provide Motorola Solutions a competitive advantage on revenue, cost, cash, and delivery.The Motorola Solutions Demand Planning team plays a critical role in the global supply chain, ensuring that the company can meet the needs of its customers around the world. The team's primary responsibility is to create and manage the global demand plan for Motorola Solutions' diverse portfolio of products. The team works to anticipate the needs of a wide range of customers, from first responders who depend on essential devices like two-way radios and the supporting network infrastructure, to enterprises that utilize video security products like body-worn cameras, video management software, and AI-powered analytics. This requires a deep understanding of market trends, product lifecycles, and regional sales forecasts to ensure that all products are available when and where they're needed. Demand planning is also highly cross-functional. The team collaborates with many different teams to create a unified demand signal that is a critical input to the company's Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle, which is used to align business functions and drive strategic decision-making.Job DescriptionThe Supply Chain Data Analyst Intern will have the opportunity to manage a portion of a Demand Analyst portfolio, which offers real-time experience in demand planning activities. The intern will also be responsible for executing daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting to assist the planning organization as well as perform analyses and assist with projects cross-functionally within the broader supply chain organization. In addition, the SC Data Analyst Intern will be expected to complete a summer project that focuses on a specific deliverable with measurable benefit to the business. The summer program will conclude with a presentation of the summer project to MSI executives and senior leaders. Preferred Skills:Analytical and Quantitative Skills: comfortable with numbers, data analysis, and statistical concepts and should be able to interpret data, identify trends, and use this information to build forecastsProficiency in Microsoft Excel: A strong command of Excel is essential. This includes using functions like VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, SUMIFS, and creating charts and reports to analyze large datasets.Communication Skills: clearly and concisely present findings, explain methodology, and collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders. Both written and verbal communication are critical.Attention to Detail: Demand planning involves working with large amounts of data, where small errors can have a significant impact. An intern must be meticulous and detail-oriented to ensure accuracy in their work.Problem-Solving: The intern should be able to approach challenges with a logical and structured mindset, helping to identify root causes of forecasting errors and proposing solutions.Time management: Ability to prioritize work between daily tasks, summer project, and other intern projects in an effective mannerTeamwork: Ability to work effectively in a team setting to make decisions and drive results #LI-MM4#LI-HYBRID Basic Requirements Candidates must be pursuing a Bachelors Degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Business, Mathematics or EngineeringMust have a graduation date on or after December 2027 Travel RequirementsNoneRelocation ProvidedNonePosition TypeInternEEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team. We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

At Deloitte Audit & Assurance, you'll join a collaborative team that fuels your growth through real, hands-on experience from day one. Our client-centric, multi-disciplinary approach makes us the premier choice in audit and assurance, and our continued investment in innovation means you'll be building the future of the profession alongside the best in the business. As an intern in Deloitte’s Audit & Assurance practice, you'll experience the auditing profession from a real-world perspective. You’ll get in-depth exposure to the auditing profession and learn more about the day-to-day responsibilities of an auditor. You’ll receive guidance and work closely with experienced audit professionals, as well as have the opportunity to participate in networking activities. You’ll have exposure to issues shaping and affecting the profession today as well as topics related to your own career development. Your coach will serve as a vital source of information and advice, offering timely, constructive feedback on your performance. Recruiting for this role ends on October 11, 2026. Work You’ll DoDuring your internship, you’ll sharpen your analytical skills as you audit client financials, transactions and internal control processes. You’ll work with audit team members and learn how to apply concepts of risk assessment and how to design and perform audit procedures responsive to those risks. You will execute these audit procedures using our cutting-edge audit tools and technologies that use artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, data visualizations and process flow automation to perform data interrogation and analysis of client data.You'll have the opportunity to work across our Audit and Assurance offerings — including Audit, Specialized Assurance, Accounting & Reporting, Controls, and Internal Audit — bringing together diverse skills, leading-edge technology, and a global network to deliver high-quality audits, assurance reports, and insights that shape how organizations report and operate. You will build adaptable, transferable skillsets that are critical for future leaders as the profession evolves.As a Financial Statement Audit intern, you may:Work alongside experienced audit professionals to deliver high-quality financial statement audits for leading clients across a variety of industriesDevelop a strong foundation in accounting, auditing, risk assessment, and professional judgment through real client work and structured learningGain hands-on experience performing audit procedures over key financial statement accounts, transactions, and disclosuresHelp evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls related to financial reportingAnalyze financial information and supporting documentation to identify risks, trends, and potential issuesPrepare clear, accurate, and well-organized audit documentation in line with professional standards and firm methodologyCollaborate directly with client personnel and engagement teams to gather information, resolve questions, and support audit executionUse innovative tools, data analytics, and emerging technologies to enhance audit quality and efficiency The successful candidate would possess these skills:Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines The TeamLaunch your career where curiosity meets impact. At Deloitte Audit & Assurance, you'll join a collaborative team that fuels your growth through real, hands-on experience from day one. You'll have the opportunity to work across Audit, Specialized Assurance, Accounting & Reporting, Controls, and Internal Audit — bringing together diverse skills, leading-edge technology, and a global network to deliver high-quality audits, assurance reports, and insights that shape how organizations report and operate. Our client-centric, multi-disciplinary approach makes us the premier choice in audit and assurance, and our continued investment in innovation means you'll be building the future of the profession alongside the best in the business. Together makes progress — and it starts with you.QualificationsRequired:Pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting or related fieldDefinitive plans to meet minimum educational requirements for CPA licensure (which may differ from the educational requirements to sit for the CPA exam) in the state of your assigned office location prior to beginning full-time employmentStrong academic record, cumulative GPA of 3.0 or aboveYou should reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if requiredYou can expect to co-locate on average 3 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locationsAbility to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serveLimited immigration sponsorship may be availableCandidates must be at least 18 years of age at the time of employment Preferred:Dual major/minor in technology related degree or area such as management information systems, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, data analytics, engineering, information science/management and mathCumulative GPA of 3.2 or aboveRelevant work experience or work experience in a professional environment (e.g., internships, summer positions, school jobs)Demonstrated recent leadership role(s), such as in a campus club, society, sports teams or other activity The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $28.23 to $56.67.

jobs.title: Customer Success Intern (Youth Soccer) at Fussbally
jobs.description: Employer: Fussbally Expires: 10/12/2026 About FussballyFussbally is one of Colorado's fastest-growing youth soccer organizations, serving hundreds of families across the Denver metro area through technical training, competitive leagues, camps, and player development programs. Our mission is to help children build confidence, athleticism, soccer skills, and a love for the game in a positive, high-quality environment.About the RoleThe Customer Experience Intern is at the heart of what keeps Fussbally families coming back. When a parent has a question, a concern, or isn't sure what's next for their player, you're one of the first people they talk to. You'll get them answers, help them find the right program, and make sure they feel like part of something special.This isn't a coffee-run internship. Fussbally is a startup that's growing fast, which means real responsibility from day one, working directly alongside company leadership, and seeing the impact of your work right away. There's no layer of bureaucracy between your ideas and the people who can act on them. Because you'll be closest to our families, you'll be one of the best-positioned people on the team to spot what could be better, and to help us build it.This role is a strong fit for someone interested in customer experience, communications, psychology, education, or sports management who wants hands-on experience at a company that's scaling fast. It's not a short-term gig, either. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.Core ResponsibilitiesFamily Communication & SupportBe a go-to point of contact for Fussbally families, answering questions quickly and with careHelp resolve parent concerns and follow through until every family feels taken care ofKeep families in the loop on schedule changes, program updates, and what's coming nextLeagues & ProgramsHelp keep our league teams full each week by confirming attendance and coordinating substitutesGuide families toward the right programs, groups, leagues, and camps for their playerLearn Fussbally's level-based training system and help families understand their player's development pathwayRetention & Building What's NextHelp develop and test strategies to keep families engaged season over seasonSpot patterns in family questions and feedback, and turn them into ideas that improve the experiencePlay an active role in building our customer experience processes from the ground up. Our systems are always evolving, and your ideas will shape them.What You'll GainReal responsibility at a fast-growing startup, not just support tasksDirect mentorship from company leadershipA front-row seat to how a youth sports business is built and scaledHands-on experience in customer experience, communication, and problem solving that you can point to in future interviewsRoom to grow: as Fussbally expands into new locations and programs, so do the opportunities on our teamIdeal Candidate ProfileThe ideal candidate:Communicates clearly and warmly, and can adjust tone for different families and situationsHas a strong ownership mindset. When something lands on your plate, you see it through to the finish.Stays calm when a conversation gets tough and focuses on solutionsCan manage a steady flow of conversations without letting anything slipHas an eye for improving systems. You notice when something could work better and have ideas for fixing it.Has a genuine interest in youth sports and the impact this work has on kids and familiesPreferred ExperienceCustomer service, hospitality, or any role involving a lot of communication with peopleYouth sports, coaching, camp, or experience working with kids and familiesComfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quicklySchedule20 to 30 hours per weekIn person, Denver metro areaApplication Question(s)At Fussbally, players are grouped by skill level, not age, so where a child gets placed can be a sensitive topic for families. A parent strongly disagrees with a leveling decision made for their child. Walk us through how you'd handle that conversation.Tell us about a time a problem landed on your desk that wasn't technically your responsibility. What did you do?

jobs.description: Employer: Artagon Expires: 10/13/2026 Artagon est une association d’intérêt général dédiée au soutien, à la promotion et à l’accompagnement de la création et des cultures émergentes, en prise avec les enjeux sociétaux actuels.Elle propose toute l’année une pluralité de programmes – création et gestion de lieux ressource, formations, bourses, événements – destinés aux étudiant·es en art, aux artistes et aux professionnel·les de la culture en début de parcours.Artagon est aujourd’hui à la tête de deux lieux ressource dédiés à l’accompagnement de la création émergente en France, avec un fort ancrage local : Artagon Marseille et Artagon Pantin en région parisienne.Avec plus de 7 000 m² d’espaces de travail, de formation et de production, qui rassemblent une centaine de résidents en simultané, Artagon pilote ainsi la première pépinière culturelle pluridisciplinaire et multirégionale en France.Fondée en 2014 par le duo de directeurs artistiques et de commissaires d’exposition Anna Labouze & Keimis Henni, ses actions sont portées par une équipe d’une dizaine de personnes.Afin de soutenir le développement de ses activités dans le champ de la formation professionnelle, l’association Artagon propose un stage au sein de son organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi, créé en 2025.Artagon accompagne les artistes et porteur·euses de projets culturels dans le développement de leurs compétences et la structuration de leurs parcours professionnels. Les formations proposées sont conçues au plus près des réalités du secteur.Au sein de l’écosystème culturel, le stage offre une immersion concrète dans le fonctionnement d’un organisme de formation. Le poste s’inscrit dans une logique de suivi des personnes intéressées pour s’inscrire à une formation, avec un accompagnement attentif pour faciliter leur accès aux formations et les aider dans leurs démarches de financement. L’objectif est de garantir un accompagnement personnalisé, depuis la prise de contact jusqu’à l’accès effectif aux formations.Le/la stagiaire travaillera en lien direct avec la responsable de l’organisme de formation et participera activement à l’expérience des personnes souhaitant intégrer une formation, de leur premier contact jusqu’à l’issue de la formation.Ce que vous allez apprendreComprendre le fonctionnement d’un organisme de formation certifié (Qualiopi)Développer des compétences en relation client dans un contexte B2CDécouvrir les mécanismes de financement de la formation professionnelleParticiper au développement et à la diffusion d’offres de formationUtiliser des outils de suivi (CRM, devis, facturation)Gagner en réflexe et en autonomie dans la gestion de projetsMissions principales1. Suivi de relation clientAssurer le suivi des personnes intéressées tout au long de leur parcours d’inscription.Répondre aux demandes d’informations, assurer un premier niveau de relation commerciale et orienter selon les besoins.Contribuer à la qualité de l’expérience et à la satisfaction.2. Appui à la gestion administrative et suivi commercialContribuer au suivi administratif des dossiers.Assurer le suivi des devis (édition, envoi, relance).Effectuer les relances commerciales (devis, factures, paiements).Mettre à jour les outils de suivi et bases de données.3. Participation à l’organisation des formationsContribuer à la préparation logistique des sessions.Être un point de contact pour les stagiaires tout au long de la formation.Suivre les retours (questionnaires, bilans).Archiver les documents administratifs.4. Veille et diffusion des offresRéaliser une veille sur les plateformes, annuaires et sites spécialisés dans la formation.Identifier les opportunités de diffusion des offres de formation.Mettre à jour et publier les formations sur les plateformes et annuaires pertinents.Garantir la bonne visibilité des offres sur les supports de diffusion externes.Profil recherchéFormation en commerce, marketing ou équivalentIntérêt pour le développement d’activité et la relation avec les publicsBonne aisance relationnelle et rédactionnelleOrganisation, rigueur et sens des prioritésIntérêt pour la vente et le développement commercialEsprit d’initiative, réactivité et autonomieMaîtrise des outils bureautiquesSensibilité pour le milieu culturel et appétence pour le secteur de la formation

jobs.title: Customer Analytics Intern at Haworth
jobs.description: Employer: Haworth Expires: 10/14/2026 Customer Analytics InternCompany OverviewAt Haworth, we're not just creating office furniture; we're shaping dynamic workspaces. As a global leader in workspace solutions, we're on a journey to redefine the future of work. Our headquarters in Holland, MI, is the hub of innovation, and we are excited to bring on our summer 2025 intern cohort to help continue driving creativity and progress. Why HaworthHaworth is a global leader in workspace design, with a legacy of innovation spanning over 70 years. As a family-owned business, Haworth maintains the agility and customer-focus of a smaller company while designing and manufacturing products that are distributed worldwide. Interns join one of Haworth's dedicated product, manufacturing, or service teams, gaining hands-on experience working directly with industry experts. Projects provide exposure to Haworth's full portfolio, from award-winning furniture to architectural interior products and comprehensive workspace solutions.Haworth's culture is defined by connectivity, collaboration, and continual learning. We foster a work environment where employees actively engage with our spaces and products. Our headquarters doubles as a dynamic showroom, where many dealers and customers visit to experience our designs firsthand. This unique environment allows you to interact directly with the spaces and furniture you help create, fostering a deeper connection to your work and the impact it has on our clients. Job OverviewWe are currently looking for a paid Customer Analytics Intern to join our team in Holland, MI. This position will be working onsite at the Haworth Corporate Headquarters. The Customer Operations Department acts as the liaison between dealers and the manufacturing/shipping teams, ensuring that orders and schedules run smoothly. As an intern on this team, you will contribute to projects such as creating predictive analyses using customer data by examining key metrics, evaluating survey platforms, and applying machine learning techniques. This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys data-driven problem solving and utilizing innovative technologies. Get ready for an adventurous summer as a Haworth intern!You'll join a cohort of around 50 other dynamic interns for a 12 week program packed with hands-on learning. After a few weeks you’ll be attending NeoCon, the largest commercial design event in the world. There you will get an insider's look at all the latest industry trends and innovations. Throughout the summer you will dive into real projects that will give you a taste of what it's like to work in a leading business and manufacturing environment.Each week brings new experiences as a group. Sharpen your skills with interactive workshops on networking, public speaking, and using AI tools in a business environment. Connect with mentors and see all areas of the office and manufacturing processes. Then unwind at intern-only social events where you can meet people from all corners of the business. By the end of the summer, you'll leave with real skills, an expanded professional network, and memories to last a lifetime. This is your chance to take your career to new heights! Required QualificationsPart-time or full-time college enrollment, working towards a Bachelor’s degree in AI, Data Science, Data Analytics or Statistics with at least a junior level status by Fall of 2027.Ability to work onsite in Holland, MI from May 2027 to August 2027.Applicant must possess an unrestricted right to work in the US to be eligible for the position. Preferred QualificationsOverall GPA of 2.95 or higher.Python experience - plus.Machine learning interest/experience - plus.AI Interest- plus.Business Analytics tools experience.Excel experience.ERP Systems experience.Previous employment experience.Previous internship experience. Extracurricular activity experience such as athletics, clubs, volunteer work, etc. Ideally, you have also demonstrated the following:Ability to work with minimal supervision.Working knowledge of personal computers, spreadsheet applications and keyboard skills.Desire to learn, question, and research solutions to problems.Organized with the ability to manage deadlines.Good verbal and written communication skills.

jobs.title: Aviation Analyst Intern at Cignus Consulting
jobs.description: Employer: Cignus Consulting Expires: 10/14/2026 About CignusCignus Consulting is an SBA 8(a)-certified, MBE/DBE aviation technology and engineering firm headquartered in Leesburg, Virginia. Since 2007 we have supported the FAA, NASA, DoD, airport authorities, and aviation clients with systems engineering, airspace and airside simulation, aviation data analytics, and software products built on standards like SWIM, ADS-B, and ARINC 424. Our work ranges from federal task orders and SBIR research to commercial simulation and digital twin platforms.We are a small team doing technically serious work, which means the person in this role will do real research, not observe it.The RoleWe are looking for an Aviation Analyst Intern to support our research in runway and surface safety. One effort extends runway incursion and approach risk monitoring across major airports. The other brings surface surveillance to the many U.S. towered airports that cannot justify the cost of ASDE-X.This role supplies the operational aviation judgment the research depends on. Our engineers build the models, but deciding whether a controller's instruction was actually complied with takes someone who understands how the operation works.What You Will DoReview archived ground and tower audio, correct model transcriptions, and annotate what was said (callsigns, taxi routes, runway assignments, hold-short instructions, crossing authorizations) to build the evaluation sets our speech models are measured againstAnnotate aircraft and vehicle movements in recorded surveillance and camera data, identifying what each target was doing and where the evidence becomes ambiguousCompile a register of runway incursions and anomalous events from ASRS, NTSB, ASIAS, and FAA Runway Safety sources, and assess which ones can be reconstructed from our archivesProduce the ground-truth datasets used to measure detection rate, false alert rate, and alert lead timeCoordinate quarterly reviews with our expert panel of controllers, pilots, and airport operations staff, including scheduling, pre-read materials, and recordsRequired QualificationsCurrent student or recent graduate in aviation management, aerospace engineering, professional flight, air traffic management, or a related disciplineAviation background through flight training, ATC coursework or training, or work experience at an airport, airline, FBO, or flight schoolEnough operational familiarity to follow a ground control frequency and anticipate what should happen next. A pilot certificate or ATC coursework is the strongest indicator we look forConsistency and attention to detail across long annotation tasks. Labeling is the foundation the research rests on, and inconsistency propagates silently into every downstream resultWorking comfort with Python notebooks, or the ability to get there quickly. Substantial programming experience is not requiredU.S. work authorizationPreferred QualificationsPrivate pilot certificate or higher, or completion of an FAA AT-CTI or comparable ATC programFamiliarity with ASDE-X, ADS-B, NOTAM, ATIS, or METAR dataExperience with video or audio annotation toolsPrior exposure to FAA or NASA datasetsInterest in a career in aviation safety, air traffic management, or aviation technologyWork StructureRemote or hybrid. Remote candidates are welcome, and candidates in the DC region are invited to work from our Leesburg office. You will need to be available for regular working sessions during U.S. Eastern business hours. Compensation$20 to $30 per hour, depending on academic level and aviation experience. To ApplySend a resume and a short note on one aviation experience (a flight lesson, a tower visit, a class project, an airport job) where you had to figure out what was really happening in the operation, and how you figured it out.

with the development, modification, and troubleshooting of PLC programs to support customer automation and control projects.Assist with the development and modification of HMI applications for jobs.description: Employer: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort Expires: 10/14/2026 As a Golf Intern at Bandon Dunes Golf Resort, you'll get real hands-on experience at one of the world's top golf destinations while pursuing your Professional Golf Management degree. You'll work directly with guests, manage our golf shop, coordinate tournaments, and learn the business side of golf operations. This isn't just shadowing someone—you'll have actual responsibilities that matter to our guests' experiences on courses that rank among the top 16 public courses in America.About Bandon Dunes Golf Resort:Bandon Dunes is a world-class golf resort located on the Oregon Coast near the charming community of Bandon. Guests come to experience golf as it was meant to be at Bandon Dunes' six distinct golf courses. That includes five 18-hole courses, which all rank among the top 16 public courses in the United States, according to Golf Digest. The resort is also home to an award-winning par-3 course, Bandon Preserve. A second par-3 course, Shorty's, will open in 2024. The two short courses are 'Courses with a Mission,' with all net proceeds funding the Bandon Dunes Charitable Foundation. The Foundation supports communities along the South Coast of Oregon.Beyond premier golf, guests delight in a variety of dining options at Bandon Dunes’ collection of restaurants. Whether you're looking to enjoy locally-sourced, Pacific-Northwest cuisine accompanied by an award-winning wine list, or prefer kicking back in a Scottish-style setting with traditional pub fare and local microbrews, there is something for everyone.Working at Bandon Dunes is a dream for golf fans, outdoor enthusiasts, and hospitality professionals alike. The Bandon Dunes team works together to create trips of a lifetime for our guests. We are passionate stewards of our resort, our community, and our environment. As an endlessly curious group, we ask questions, share ideas, and always look for a better way. With a hard-working attitude, we help guide our guests through their pure golf experience, immersed in Oregon’s natural beauty and away from the demands of daily life.What You'll Do:Learn the retail side of golf. You'll become an expert on our golf shop merchandise, help guests find what they need, and handle special orders. This means understanding products well enough to make real recommendations, not just ringing up sales.Handle real transactions. You'll process merchandise sales, greens fees, and equipment rentals while keeping accurate records. You'll learn the financial side of golf operations through actual daily work, not textbook theory.Provide genuine customer service. You'll answer guest questions, schedule tee times, and maintain professional phone interactions. When guests call, you'll be the voice they hear representing Bandon Dunes.Support tournaments and events. You'll help organize competitions and special events, coordinating between different departments to make sure everything runs smoothly. This is where you'll see how all the moving pieces fit together.Manage inventory and operations. You'll help keep merchandise displays organized, assist with inventory counts, and support various services like handicapping systems and driving range operations.What Makes You a Great Fit:You're pursuing a Professional Golf Management degree. We work with certified PGM programs and prefer students who can commit to a 6-month internship. This gives you enough time to really learn the business, not just get a quick overview.You communicate well. Strong written and verbal skills matter here because you'll interact with guests from around the world. You need to sound professional on the phone and explain complex golf services clearly.You can handle multiple priorities. Golf operations move fast, and you'll need to manage several tasks while staying calm under pressure. If you get flustered easily when things get busy, this probably isn't the right fit.You're flexible with your schedule. Golf doesn't stop for weekends or holidays. You'll work evenings, weekends, and busy periods when our guests need us most.Special Intern Benefits:Shared staff housing available for a reasonable fee, mentorship from industry professionals, and the chance to play golf for free on seven award-winning courses.If you're serious about a career in golf and want to learn the business at one of the world's premier destinations, we'd like to hear from you. This internship will give you real experience you can't get in a classroom, plus the chance to build relationships with industry professionals. You'll work hard, but you'll also get to play some of the best golf of your life on your days off.Ready to embark on an enriching journey in the world of golf? Apply today to become a Golf Intern at Bandon Dunes Golf Resort and be part of a team dedicated to providing one of the world’s most exceptional golfing experiences.At Bandon Dunes Golf Resort, we are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
